title: Modal
description: Global modal host. Mount once near the app root. Imperative API: showModal(config) / closeModal() exported from the module script.

showModal.description: Opens a modal with the given configuration.

params.name: config
params.description: Modal config: title (string), description? (string), snippet? (Snippet), component? (Component), componentProps? (object), buttons (array of { label, variant?, onClick(close) }).
